<thought>The 13C NMR shows two signals in the aromatic region (≈135.8 ppm and 117.4 ppm). Such a pattern is typical for a symmetric aromatic ring (e.g., a para‑disubstituted benzene) where the six aromatic carbons give only two distinct chemical shifts. Therefore the molecule contains six aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
